full_page.content:
Page 36
June 20 Mrs. H. Carriere - 75 - fearfully burned - scalded by boiling coffee - had been taking active part in "Shower" - hopes to get home soon .. Dr. said possibly by end of July. Accident happened April 3rd.
Loretta Kelly - 16 - spastic paralysis ever since birth - can talk a little - seems intelligent and makes best of sad condition.
Mary Jane Krentler - 23 - spinal trouble. Drs seem to be in doubt just what the trouble may be. The patient works but feels exhausted and nerveous from the peculiar pain in back.
22 V. Sister Mary Paula - Felician - 29yrs in Community. Dr. thinks it floating kidney. Enrolled To-day.
22 Thomas Lents - 42 - Marysville - nerve-break.
Jacob Ebeling - lutheran - 48 - heart.
Mrs. Stella Ring1 - 34 - very threatening Knee. ... Henry O'neill - 42 - "Berger's" disease - smoking .... Mrs. Eva Sarty - 37 - upset ... buying New house.
Page 37 June 24 James Donohue 13 - broken apendex - in bad shape. Betty J. Matushek - 7 - peculiar infection besides rumatic fever .... Mrs. Van Dyke - about 45 - lump in side size of tumbler ....
27 Baby Mary L. Sheehan - 7 mo. - hurt at birth and not normal. Was enrolled some weeks ago and quite improved - but still far from normal.
27 Beulah McEachen - 26 - serious eye trouble every summer ...
29 Nancy Rollins - 7 - broken sholder.
Albert Joseph Knight - 4 - groth very much like cancer on kidney ... Enrolled To-day 2.00
Alex Czarnecke - 91 - baptized Catholic - away from church for many many years - stuborn.
30 Stephen Dillworth - baby - 15 mo. - cleff pallet - operation to-mor- row.
Pat McQuade - 54 - cancer of lungs - very poorly. Drs. have no hope. Enrolled To-day.
